output.diagnosis: spec_error: DWELL without max_speed counts any presence (1.835s transit) as stay, so drive-through passes. Intent of 'stay' needs near-stopped time. Strict 0.05/0.10 +1500ms over-rejects brief_stop labelled PASS with 1200-1600ms strict-still due to jitter/creep fragmentation, so need stillness below belt speed ~0.118 with slightly reduced min_ms for tolerance.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample: 0ms still <1100ms -> FAIL fixed. Drive-through with transit>1500 but speed~0.118>0.08 stays FAIL. Brief_stop with 1200-1600ms still now PASS, removing regressions.
proposals.rationale: 'stay' means nearly still, not transit. 0.08 rejects belt-speed transit ~0.118 but tolerates jitter, and 1100ms keeps 1.5s intent with tolerance for fragmented still measurement.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample FAIL (0<1000). Brief_stop 1200+ PASS with margin for fragmentation. Canonical long stops stay PASS.
proposals.rationale: Strict stopped definition with lower dwell threshold to separate 0ms drive-through from 1200ms+ brief stops while preserving stay intent.

proposals.expected_effect: Counterexample FAIL. Brief_stop borderline 1200ms PASS if continuous; more conservative toward 1.5s text but less margin for jitter than P1/P2.
proposals.rationale: Minimal reduction from 1500ms that still includes 1200ms labelled PASS examples, with 0.07 still below drive-through speed to require true stop.
